update.title: Proposed a three-stage project for applied AI integration
update.summary: Proposed a three-stage engineering program spanning AI software, robotics hardware, and a final integration project, with reviews and deliverables guiding each phase.

preview.description: First page of the independent AI integration program proposal

blocks.body:
## Plan from software to physical systems

I wrote the proposal to turn a broad interest in applied AI into a concrete engineering program with three connected phases:

1. **AI & Software** — research practical uses, build local prototypes, and establish evaluation methods.
2. **Robotics & Hardware** — apply that foundation to sensors, control, and physical engineering constraints.
3. **Integration & Final Project** — combine the disciplines in a working system and document the result.

blocks.description: The proposal defines the staged work, deliverables, risks, and evaluation plan.
